User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the LocalLooms platform.

location.description: User's current location for personalized event suggestions. Stored as a GeoPoint (latitude, longitude).

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event posted on the LocalLooms platform.

userId.description: Reference to User who created the event. (Relationship: User 1:N Event)

startTime.description: The start date and time of the event.

endTime.description: The end date and time of the event.

location.description: Location of the event. Stored as a GeoPoint (latitude, longitude).

category.description: Category of the event (e.g., Music, Sports, Food).

definition.description: Stores user profile information.  Path-based ownership ensures only the user can read/write their profile.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores all events created on the platform. Events are publicly readable but writable only by their creators. This structure supports efficient querying for public event discovery while maintaining user-level write permissions through security rules that check the `userId` field within the document.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The unique identifier of the event.
